description:
G2	Ash-Leaved Maple x 2	Neighbouring Drive: 15a -17a

Reduce new growth to previous reduction points (3m-3.5m) Height & Spread, retaining good growth furnishings to support crown development.
If required, thin the branch structure to help create an even balance.
Remove dead branches over 2.5cm in diameter.
Inspect the crown for any adverse conditions and advise if necessary.

The tree's current height is 18m, and its crown spread is 9m
After the proposed works, the tree's height is 14.5m, and the crown spread is 7m 

T3. Lime Tree	Neighbouring Drive: 15a -17a

Reduce/pollard new growth to previous reduction points (4m-4.5m), retaining good growth buds to support crown development.
If required, thin the branch structure to help create an even balance.
Remove dead branches over 2.5cm in diameter.
Inspect the crown for any adverse conditions and advise if necessary.

The tree's current height is 18m, and its crown spread is 9m
After the proposed works, the tree's height is 13.5m, and the crown spread is 4m
